## Overview

Receipt is a fixed-width, vertically stacked transaction summary with a decorative watermark, transaction header, sender and recipient rows, amount and fee details, date and transaction metadata, and footer guidance. The `Property` axis exposes `Receipt` and `Transaction Success`; the success variant adds a 96px confirmation banner and is 76px taller. The extraction records semantic color bindings for Light and Dark modes and no interactive focus stops.

**Variant axes.** `Property`: `Receipt`, `Transaction Success` (default: `Transaction Success`).

### Composition

- _Decorative children: 2 — documented inline in Structure and Color._

## Voice / Screen reader

_Confidence: medium — the extraction contains visible text and structural order but no authored accessibility metadata._

Treat Receipt as static informational content. Do not make the card shell, `bg`, `contents`, watermark, dividers, or layout frames independently focusable. Preserve a logical reading order of confirmation status when present, transaction type, sender, recipient, amount and fees, date/time, visible transaction identifiers, and footer guidance. The success icon is decorative when the adjacent `Transaction Confirmed` text is exposed; do not announce the icon and title twice.

The voice extraction found no interactive focus stops. A runtime may expose the whole receipt as one non-interactive accessibility group or let native text flow naturally; it must not invent button, link, input, or live-region semantics from the visual design alone.

### State: transaction success

Canonical `Property=Transaction Success`. The extracted state contains a visible confirmation banner, success icon, title, transaction details, and footer text.

#### VoiceOver (iOS)

_No focus-stop tables extracted._

| Property | Value | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Grouping | One static informational group or native text flow | Do not expose every layout frame as a stop. |
| Reading order | Confirmation title → transaction type → from → to → amount/fees → date/IDs → footer | Keep the semantic order stable. |
| Do NOT | Announce `heroicons-solid/check-circle` separately | The success title carries the meaningful status. |

#### TalkBack (Android)

_No focus-stop tables extracted._

| Reading order | Same as the visual content order | Include only visible transaction ID rows. |
| Do NOT | Expose the watermark, dividers, or success glyph as independent nodes | They are decorative. |
